meta.name: linkedin-thread-monitor
meta.description: Track which of your LinkedIn comments earned author replies. Flags the 6-24h warm-reply window where thread momentum peaks, classifies threads as hot/warm/cool/dormant, and routes warm ones to linkedin-reply-handler for follow-up drafts. Powered by Apify, no LinkedIn login. Triggers on "what threads need follow-up", "author replied", "monitor my comments". Not for analyzing likers on a post (use linkedin-engager-analytics).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪你的 LinkedIn 评论是否被作者回复,并在互动最佳时机提醒你跟进
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常在 LinkedIn 评论并想及时跟进作者的回复。
copy.tagline_en: Track which comments got author replies and catch the best moment to follow up
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you comment actively on LinkedIn and want to follow up when authors reply.

howto.what: Claude 会追踪你的 LinkedIn 评论里哪些收到了作者回复,把帖子分成 hot、warm、cool、dormant 四档,标出 6-24 小时的回复窗口,并把 warm 帖子交给 linkedin-reply-handler 起草跟进。没配 APIFY_TOKEN 时,改为让你粘贴评论链接。
howto.when: 当你提到「哪些帖子需要跟进」「作者回复了」等说法,或要求监控自己的评论时触发;发完一批评论后想隔几小时回查也适用。默认回溯窗口 72 小时。

say.text: 今天有哪些帖子需要跟进?
say.note: 输出近期评论表,含作者回复状态和建议动作

say.text: 作者回复我了,帮我起草回应
我发的评论里哪些已经冷了?
say.note: 标出超过 72 小时的 dormant 帖子

howto.what_en: Claude tracks which of your LinkedIn comments earned author replies, sorts threads as hot/warm/cool/dormant, flags the 6-24h warm-reply window, and routes warm ones to linkedin-reply-handler for drafts. Without APIFY_TOKEN, you paste comment URLs instead.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask what threads need follow-up, say an author replied, or ask to monitor your comments; also after posting a batch of comments. Default window is 72 hours.

say_en.note: Table of recent comments with reply status and next action

say_en.text: The author replied — draft my response
say_en.note: Sends warm threads to linkedin-reply-handler for drafts

say_en.text: Which of my comments have gone cold?
